reviews.comment: Professor Cordes is my favorite teacher I have had in college thus far. She will make you love Ocean Engineering! She is a great lecturer and really gets you into the major. She is a great advisor and really cares about your success within the program. Do the homework, go to her office hours, and ask questions in class. She will reward you.
Amazing professor, I hope I get to have another class with professor Cordes in the future. I forgot to do the course evaluations so I came here to say that this class made me love Ocean Engineering.

Professor Cordes is amazing; she cares about her students and knows each of them. She is there to help with any questions and will be quick to go back over something someone needs help understanding. This excellent course gives you the basic knowledge you need for the next couple of years. The homework tremendously helps with the tests

Professor Cordes sold me on Ocean Engineering. There is not a better professor in the entire university. Her homework helps you out so much on the exams and understanding the dynamics of Ocean Engineering. She cares for her students and wants you to walk away with as much knowledge as possible!
